prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a hand holding a smartphone horizontally, displaying a streaming video on its screen. The hand, with dark skin and long, glossy, hot pink acrylic nails, is prominently in the foreground, sharply in focus. On the phone’s screen, a scene from a sitcom is playing, showing two men sitting on a couch in a cozy, warmly lit living room set, with yellow subtitles visible. In the upper right corner of the phone screen, two small video call windows show expressive faces of people reacting to the show—one wearing colorful glasses and the other with pink hair. The background is softly blurred, with neutral tones and gentle natural light, drawing all attention to the phone and hand. The overall color palette is a mix of warm browns and beiges from the background, contrasted by the vibrant pink nails and the colorful, dynamic content on the phone screen. The composition uses a shallow depth of field and a slight angle, creating an intimate, immersive, and contemporary feel, as if capturing a candid moment of digital connection and entertainment.
